reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for defining, validating, registering, and running configurable multi-expert teams through lead and specialist child-agent workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的多专家团队定义、校验、技能注册以及协调者与专长代理调度能力。
summaries.en: Provides configurable multi-expert teams for DeepSeek Harness, including team validation, routable skill registration, and lead-to-specialist child-agent orchestration.

capabilities: Scans and validates expert-team directories and configuration files
Automatically registers each valid team as a routable skill
Starts a lead child agent and dynamically dispatches specialist child agents
Provides scripts to create and validate team scaffolds
